per_claim.notes: Single circular chromosome confirmed. Length difference of 0.10% is well within expected variation between different assemblers (Flye vs. HGAP/similar) on the same PacBio raw reads.
Paper reported 45% which is consistent with the computed 45.68% when rounded to the nearest integer.

Coverage difference of ~10x is expected given different assemblers and coverage calculation methods. Total read bases (1.30 Gb) divided by assembly size (~6.0 Mb) gives ~217x raw coverage, consistent with paper's 215x. Flye's 205x reflects post-assembly mapped coverage.
Difference of 7 CDS out of >5,200 is well within annotation pipeline variation (Prokka vs paper's pipeline). Less than 0.15% difference.
IBSD35 confirmed as closest relative by both skani ANI and Mash distance, though the margin over HS311 is very narrow (0.03% ANI). Paper's phylogenetic claim is supported.

antiSMASH 8.0.4 (2024) detects 19 BGCs vs paper's 12 from an older antiSMASH version (~v5/v6 era). The 7 additional clusters are attributable to new detection rules added in subsequent antiSMASH releases (RRE-containing, cyclic-lactone-autoinducer, proteusin, etc.). All 12 original clusters are subsumed within the 19. This is a tool-version effect, not a contradiction.

All six named BGCs (fusaricidin, polymyxin, tridecaptin, pelgipeptin, paenilan, paeninodin) identified via MIBiG knownclusterblast with matching gene counts. Coordinate offsets are explained by circular-origin rotation artifact; cluster spans match to within 1 bp in tested cases.

per_claim.delta: Raw reads confirmed at SRR10363117; no assembly at NCBI
per_claim.notes: Raw reads successfully downloaded from SRA under PRJNA580302/SRR10363117 (183,095 reads, 1.30 Gb). Paper did not deposit an annotated assembly to NCBI Assembly/Nucleotide, but the raw data availability claim is correct. The genome was successfully reconstructed from deposited data.

one_line_summary: All 10 testable claims from the paper were independently reproduced from raw reads, with numeric differences well within expected tool-version variation.
key_caveats: Assembly length differs by +0.10% due to different assembler (Flye vs paper's pipeline), within normal range for long-read assemblers on the same data.
antiSMASH 8.0.4 detects 7 additional BGC regions compared to the paper's older antiSMASH version; all 12 original clusters are recovered.
Closest relative IBSD35 is confirmed but the margin over HS311 is very narrow (ANI 97.59% vs 97.56%).
No annotated assembly was deposited by the authors to NCBI; replication relied on de novo reassembly from deposited raw reads.
